items.note_en: A different group of students — and a different deck.
items.note_zh: 換一批學生、換一套簡報。

footnote_en: Two 40-minute classes with a 10-minute break between them. No principal interview and no campus tour on this visit — the principal is away that day.
footnote_zh: 兩節課各 40 分鐘，中間休息 10 分鐘。這次沒有校長採訪與校園導覽——校長當天出差。
